❖ Overall Inflation rate remained low at an average of 4.3% in 3Q 2020 compared to 5.0% in a similar period last
year.
❖ However, the weather outlook for the October-November-December (OND) 2020 “Short Rains” season indicates
depressed rainfall in some parts of the country, hence a gradual rise in inflation into early 2021.
❖ Overall inflation is expected to remain within the maximum range of 7.5% into the close of the year.
